result:
Round 337 passes. Every acceptance row I could run did pass, and I found no bugs. I changed no app source. This round only touches the perf test harness, so I did not run the Studio find-sound → add → fit-video → export flow, and Ableton conformance does not apply.

I did not re-run `typecheck`; A reported rc 0. The full test suite, build, Biome, `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke are gate rows, so I did not claim them.

- **Claims and scope:** the claims script gives the same output at start and end of my run, and it matches the sketch values. Exactly 4 files changed (doc 233 is the only untracked one). `app/` and `perf/lib/` are untouched, and all 11 protected files are OK.
- **Budget notes:** the notes-only check reports 58 notes changed and no other field differing. The sample notes I read match the code's window and its denominator, which counts every pointermove between pointerdown and pointerup, the first included.
- **Perf run in real Chromium:** I ran the spec alone on a production build. It exited 0, was `complete` with no failures, had 193 rows, and all 36 asserted rows passed. Against the round 335 baseline there were 139 EQUAL, 0 DIFF and 0 NEW, and the row ids are identical. Every liveness row read 1 in all three passes.
- **Mutants:**
  - P recorded `MU-PROBE up-after-last-down true` and M recorded `false`; both aborted at `drag lane stopped`.
  - D changed exactly the 9 listed `move-components-per-move` rows.
  - My own mutant W (`commits.slice(1)` in `dragWindow`) changed 13 rows. They are all in the `move-components-*` family, including the lane rows and the range `move-components-max`, and none are outside it. I wrote that prediction before running it.
- **Code and docs:** the `dragWindow` bounds, `pressedGesture` (release error swallowed, original rethrown) and the read/timestamp order in both drags all match HEAD. The perf/lib report test passed 34/34. Doc 233 has the exact status line and the seven template headings. Doc 168 changed only inside `## მეტრიკები`.
- **Auth, fresh anonymous contexts at 1440×900 and 1280×720:**
  - `/studio-lab` opens the demo workspace with `auth_user` null.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and has 0 `audio[src]`.
  - `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no header.
  - A fake bearer token gets no token back.

One note for B: the old auth script waited on a `data-testid="arrangement-status"` that no longer exists. My copy waits on the status text instead, so this is not an app bug. A's unapplied reviewer Lows (renames, doc wording) are candidates for B, not bugs.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-337.md
- c-round-337.json
- c-round-337/
